entries.ab9108b94cd84780: Its strengths are a logistics base network centered on large ３ＰＬ centers for major ＥＣ operators, and an integrated logistics structure able to handle everything from transport to storage and distribution processing. Its building in-house delivery service, which centrally manages the loading and unloading of goods within large urban buildings, has a track record at major buildings including Tokyo Opera City and Roppongi Hills. entries.fc21d6093ac19dce: In July 2020, the Group formulated its long-term vision, “Higashi Group VISION2030,” and sets out as its aspirational image “a company that continues to transform in order to deliver the best service to its customers.” As the medium-term management strategy toward realizing this, it formulated the “Medium-Term Management Plan 2028” in May 2025, positioning these three years as “three years to complete the fundamentals for promotion to the Prime Market.” Under its group purpose, “Peace of mind forever, surprises more. With people, technology and ＩＴ, we create new value and connect to a prosperous tomorrow,” it says it will advance measures centered on business growth through improved service and efficiency, capturing ＥＣ demand, strengthening its ＩＴ business and similar initiatives, and further efforts in ＥＳＧ management.
